svg.title: Warming to 2100 in two scenarios
svg.desc: Time chart with 91 points from 1950 to 2100 and 3 series (Measured, Low emissions (modeled), High emissions (modeled)). Highest: 3.1 (High emissions in 2100). Lowest: −0.34 (Measured in 1954). Lines have a shaded band from its lower to its upper bound, hatched where modeled; the data table lists both.
